discrepancy_resolution.explanation: Checkpoint metadata, model implementation, and training state dictionary strictly agree: n_layers=20, emb_dim=1536, n_heads=24, num_kv_heads=4 (6:1 GQA), head_dim=64, ffn_hidden_dim=3840, rope_theta=10000.0, params=514,389,504. The mention in an earlier SFT preparation report of 16 query heads / RoPE theta 500,000 was a textual documentation typo; the actual codebase and frozen weights have always been 24 query heads and RoPE theta 10,000.0.

tool_audit.provenance_reconciliation_verdict: Speculative claims of 32k authentic Python executions in earlier reports are reconciled against actual repository files: 73,621 are APIGen demonstrations and 543 are authentic live sandbox executions. Authenticity labels will be strictly preserved in sampling manifests.

throughput_reconciliation.explanation: In Experiment A, 3,110.7 tok/s was the end-to-end total elapsed project throughput (24.9M tokens / 8,012.6 total elapsed seconds including the 15-minute cooldown break, 16 validation passes, and 8 checkpoint disk writes). The pure active training time was 118.24 minutes (3,513.1 tok/s). The difference between active training (3,513 tok/s) and isolated microbenchmark (5,136 tok/s) is explained by dataloader collate overhead and per-step Python logging.
